Corollary
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0059 1. Corollary 2.29\group neckpinch

If the solution exists on $0\le t<T$, then $\psi (x,t)$ has a pointwise limit as $t\nearrow T$ for each $x\in [-1,1]$.
